selector: Rubric-blind primary text token overlap with selected original plan question; deterministic ID tie break. Select question with least delivered primary-text coverage, then original question order; each question once when multiple; single question pages forward. Candidate schema may expose question_index; baseline uses global paging. Already delivered IDs excluded. Never read rubric during execution.

gates.manual_unsupported_claim_review: Separate required fresh-caller assessment; automated facet coverage is supporting evidence, not answer correctness.

limitations: Public development cases, not sealed or unseen evaluation.
Conditional facets are diagnostic and do not inflate essential denominators.
Acceptable any_of alternatives express bounded evidence equivalence, not claim identity.
Historical G3/G4 ID counts remain diagnostics and are not retuned into new gates.
Failed gates remain failed; changing frozen cases/rubric/policy requires a new explicit revision.
